show: The Bible in a Year (with Fr. Mike Schmitz)

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst podtrac.com) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts; Texte aus dem Begleittext des Podcasters, kein Transkript - ohne Zeitachse sind Clips und Sprungmarken unmoeglich

einzeiler: Jesus's divinity, physical and spiritual healing, and carrying the Cross.
kurzfassung: Fr. Mike Schmitz discusses Jesus's divinity and his physical, mental, and spiritual healing of people. The episode covers freeing people from the kingdom of darkness. It also addresses facing persecution and division for Christ.
stichpunkte: Physical, mental, and spiritual healing by Jesus
Freedom from the enemy's kingdom of darkness
Coping with persecution and division for Christ
Encouragement to courageously carry the Cross
beschreibung:
Fr. Mike reinforces Jesus' divinity as we read about how Jesus heals people physically, mentally, and spiritually and frees them from the enemy's kingdom of darkness. Fr. Mike also encourages us to not be afraid when we experience persecution and division for the sake of Christ, but to rather courageously carry the Cross.

For the complete reading plan, visit ascensionpress.com/bibleinayear.

Please note: The Bible contains adult themes that may not be suitable for children - parental discretion is advised.
